Class TreeMetaOptimizationProblem<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.meta.problem.AbstractMetaOptimizationProblem<S, DerivationTreeSolution>
org.uma.evolver.meta.problem.TreeMetaOptimizationProblem<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the type of solutions used by the base algorithm being optimized
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, org.uma.jmetal.problem.Problem<DerivationTreeSolution>
public class TreeMetaOptimizationProblem<S extends org.uma.jmetal.solution.Solution<?>> extends AbstractMetaOptimizationProblem<S, DerivationTreeSolution>
Meta-optimization problem using derivation tree encoding.

The tree structure mirrors the grammar of the parameter space, so only active parameters are present in each solution. This eliminates the inactive-variable problem inherent in flat double encodings.
